observed_failure.command: launchd earth.hati.day-turn and retries, 2026-10-29 19:00 .. 2026-10-31 12:40; observe/native-turn-run.bml in the walk
observed_failure.result: The 19:00 walk of 2026-10-29 spent its 149-minute window on a queue row whose band stood only in another checkout's ignored tree. Every candidate after a refused band read null for the life of the process. Each rebuild of the launchd-spawned kernel cost each job one killed spawn: on 2026-10-31 launchd killed 03:40, 12:30 and 12:40. fccw-covers read arg == fat-exit(name) since e06d7217e, so a check on a writable read as fixed.
observed_failure.cause: No band-standing check before a climb; a bad-list keyed by path alone; launchd holding an ad-hoc program to its content; a wrong line under an unread band. Each repaired at cause in kernel 9a8fdc6fb, and the launcher is installed.
